name: customers
description: New CRM customer table (mock staging store). Constraints are enforced during dry run AND again by the store on load.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Customer id, must look like cus_<legacy id>.

fields.name: email
fields.description: Lower-case e-mail. Unique across the whole customer table.

fields.name: customer_since
fields.description: ISO date the customer was created.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Commercial tier. No direct legacy equivalent.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency of the balance. Not present in the legacy export.

fields.name: account_balance_minor
fields.description: Balance in minor units (e.g. paise/cents) as an integer.
